title: Read retained prepare Git command timings
description: Set FARMSLOT_PREPARE_PROOF_RUN to the next real Mobile run and select an authenticated gateway profile. Run with FARMSLOT_PREPARE_PROOF_ACTIVE=1 after its first Git measurement to check the human stage detail, then again after prepare finishes. Reads stored snapshots only; creates no runs, commands or slot changes. Fails on missing or inconsistent Git measurements.

read.intent: Prove run.get retains each exact Git measurement and exit outcome without counting it as another phase.
